briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent frontier race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy agentic systems with o4 and Claude 4.5 leading capability gains while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute constraints and export controls shape global deployment. Safety gaps persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic followed with Claude 4.5 Opus; Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI shipped Grok 3; DeepSeek launched R2 with 2T parameters. Agentic workflows now dominate benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems; xAI reported novel jailbreak vectors in Grok 3.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramped 3nm AI chip production; Microsoft and Google announced $40B combined data center expansions; NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints continue into Q4. Sovereign AI initiatives in EU and UAE secured priority allocations.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic multi-model systems trigger a measurable capability jump sufficient for AGI claims by end of 2027?
